Chapter 10. The Hope of Final Joy: Looking Forward.
Have you ever noticed that no matter how good life gets, there’s always this quiet longing? It’s like—even in the happiest moments—you sense something’s still missing. And those moments, as sweet as they are, never seem to last. On the other hand, in the hardest seasons, there’s a hope that whispers, “This isn’t the end of the story.”
That longing? It points to something deeper. A hope for a joy that’s complete, that doesn’t fade, and that can’t be taken away.
Now, let’s be honest. For a lot of people, the promise of heaven can sound pretty distant or even a little abstract. Life gets busy. The here and now pulls us in. And sometimes, the idea of future joy feels like it’s miles away. But here’s the thing: this hope—it isn’t about running from reality. It’s about knowing, deep down, that the best really is still to come.
Picture someone who’s been through a season of deep loss. They find comfort in the promise that—one day—every tear will be wiped away. The pain is still there. It’s real. But so is the hope. And it’s that hope—the assurance of final joy—that gives us strength to endure, the courage to keep going, and the freedom to love without being held back by fear.
Most of us don’t realize just how much the hope of future joy shapes our lives right now. It gives us perspective when we’re suffering. Patience when we’re waiting. And it adds purpose to every moment, even the ordinary ones. The promise isn’t that life will be easy. But it is that, one day, every longing will be fulfilled.
And here’s something beautiful—it frees us from that nagging fear of missing out. Chasing after joy with God isn’t a race against the clock. It’s a journey toward a destination that’s already secure.
So, the hope of final joy? That’s the anchor you can count on. It’ll keep you steady, even when life’s storms roll in.
